interfaces.name: Webflow Designer
interfaces.classification_rationale: Actions are expressed by manipulating presented affordances (canvas, panels, controls) over a persistent, navigable representation of site state.

provenance.evidence: Docs describe extending the Webflow Designer, the visual editing environment.
States an agent can do through the MCP server only what a user can do in the Webflow Designer, framing the Designer as the interactive control surface.

interfaces.name: Data API
interfaces.classification_rationale: The consumer explicitly invokes provider-defined operations through structured HTTP requests over one base and auth.

provenance.evidence: RESTful endpoints to manage CMS, sites, ecommerce, forms, assets, custom code, webhooks and Enterprise configuration.

interfaces.name: Designer API
interfaces.classification_rationale: Extension code invokes provider-defined operations to read and write elements, styles, components and variables; the primitive is operation invocation, not affordance manipulation.

provenance.evidence: Designer API described as a JavaScript API that Designer Extensions use to read and write elements, styles, components, variables, pages, folders and assets.

interfaces.name: Browser API
interfaces.classification_rationale: Code on published sites invokes provider-defined operations to set custom attributes, record optimization variations and send custom goal events.

provenance.evidence: Browser API described as a client-side JavaScript API running on published sites to set attributes, record optimization variations and send goal events.

interfaces.name: Webflow CLI
interfaces.classification_rationale: The consumer invokes provider-defined operations through structured commands (auth, sites, forms, assets, cms, devlink, cloud, extension); no persistent navigable TUI is documented.

provenance.evidence: Command-based CLI to manage sites, CMS, forms and assets and to build, share and deploy code from the terminal.

interfaces.name: Webhooks
interfaces.technology: Service-initiated HTTP delivery to a subscriber receiver
interfaces.classification_rationale: The service initiates the interaction when subscribed events occur and delivers to a consumer-controlled receiver URL.

provenance.evidence: Working with Webhooks; get real-time updates when events occur on a site.

interfaces.name: MCP server
interfaces.classification_rationale: The official server exposes Webflow APIs as semantically described tools that an agent discovers and selects; capability discovery and selection structure the interaction contract.

provenance.evidence: Official MCP server exposing Webflow APIs as tools an AI agent can use to create and manage site objects.
Server at mcp.webflow.com/mcp translates intent into API calls, exposes tools and referenceable resources, and reports mode-aware tool availability.

access_mechanism_ledger.detail: Command-based CLI; no persistent navigable TUI documented.
No first-party mobile client; the Designer is browser-based and not optimized for mobile.
No first-party desktop client; the Designer runs in the browser.
